title: EU licence & warning-list check input
description: One entity (fields below) or a batch in 'entities'. Give at least one of name, lei, reg_number, domain. Each entity checked = one 'licence-check' event; malformed items are not charged.

name.title: Firm name
name.description: Legal or trading name, e.g. 'Mollie B.V.'. Legal forms (B.V., GmbH, Ltd...) and accents are normalised.

lei.title: LEI
lei.description: 20-character Legal Entity Identifier. Strongest match key; the legal name is also looked up at GLEIF (CC0) unless resolve_lei is off.

reg_number.title: Registration number
reg_number.description: The regulator's or business register's number as published in the register (e.g. DNB 'F0038', ECB RIAD code, SIREN for AMF PSAN and portfolio management companies, AMF number such as 'GP-08000008' or biens-divers 'D-19-01'). For a Dutch firm, an 8-digit KVK number with country NL also finds its LEI (and through it the register entry).

kvk.title: KVK number (NL)
kvk.description: Dutch Chamber of Commerce (KVK) number, 8 digits. Finds the firm's LEI and, through it, the register entry. Same as an 8-digit reg_number with country NL.

country.title: Home country
country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 (NL, DE, FR...). Lowers name-match confidence for firms from other countries (passported firms excepted).

domain.title: Website, domain or e-mail
domain.description: The domain you are dealing with (https://example.com, example.com or someone@example.com). Matched against warning lists and register websites; look-alike domains are flagged.

claimed_licence.title: Claimed licence
claimed_licence.description: What the firm says it is, e.g. 'payment institution NL', 'e-money', 'bank', 'MiCA CASP', 'investment firm DE'. Types we do not cover (insurance, consumer credit...) return not_covered.

as_of.title: As of date
as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Status on that date, from the registers' own authorisation/withdrawal dates and our recorded history. Default: today.

entities.title: Batch: entities
entities.description: A list of {name, lei, reg_number, country, domain, claimed_licence, as_of}. Max 500. Top-level as_of applies to all items that do not set one.

refresh.title: Refresh sources live
enumTitles: Auto: refetch sources older than max_age_hours
refresh.description: The bundled data is rebuilt every day at about 11:15 Amsterdam time from our daily copies of each register. 'auto' (default) also fetches any source older than max_age_hours live from the official file at run start (adds 5-60 s when needed); 'never' uses the bundled data only; 'always' fetches every source live.

max_age_hours.title: Max data age (hours)
max_age_hours.description: With refresh 'auto': sources whose data_as_of is older than this many hours are fetched live (default 48).

resolve_lei.title: Resolve LEI at GLEIF
resolve_lei.description: Look up the LEI's legal name at GLEIF so registers that list the firm without its LEI still match.
